stories.title: PM Shehbaz to address COP31 summit in Turkiye, highlight climate justice
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is scheduled to address the high-level segment of the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkiye, on Wednesday, highlighting Pakistan's position on climate justice and the concerns of countries affected by climate change.

stories.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Hegseth
stories.brief: Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an effort on Tuesday to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, winning a reprieve for the polarising Pentagon chief before Democrats take control of Congress next year and possibly try again.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye to address COP31 summit
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on Tuesday for a three-day visit to attend the Leaders’ Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP 31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

stories.title: US Treasury chief Bessent moved to military base after ‘Iranian threats’
stories.brief: Iran is said to have geo-located Bessent's $12.5m mansion in Washington, DC after a photo of it was published.

stories.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
stories.brief: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

stories.title: SC disposes of Imaan Mazari, Hadi Chattha's trial appeals as infructuous
stories.brief: The Supreme Court (SC) on Wednesday disposed of appeals challenging the trial in the barriers removal case involving Human rights lawyers Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha, declaring the matter infructuous as the trial had already been completed.

stories.title: US Treasury chief Bessent moved to military base after Iranian threats, sources say
stories.brief: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has recently moved from his Washington, DC residence to a US military base after Iranian threats against his life, two people familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

stories.title: Imran Khan undergoes eye treatment at PIMS, receives intravitreal injection
stories.brief: Imran has received a series of anti-VEGF intravitreal injections in his right eye as part of treatment for right central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO), a condition diagnosed after he reported reduced vision. Amid controversy surrounding the eye treatment, PIMS confirmed that Imran was administered an anti-VEGF intravitreal injection to treat right central retinal vein occlusion.
